Hi Walter.  I've initiated a Paper trading session.  There are some features and functions not processing currently.  Please explain why the following things are happening:

Even though the paper mode is set to active trading, in the filter insights tab, nothing is updating. It shows that zero pairs are eligible, and it's showing the same filter breakdown that it's been showing for since this morning for several hours. When I refresh, click the refresh button, nothing changes. So that means that the data is not filtering through. You can also see that the blue bar at the top is showing stopped. When I go to the filtered pairs tab, there are zero pairs scanned and zero eligible pairs, but that seems to be contrary to what we saw when we ran the script in the show. Ready to buy? Seems like it's updating. There are four pairs in there, and it's saying the next scan will be in 28 minutes and 45 seconds, but that is not a clock that's ticking down, and I'd be interested to know why the next scan is in 28 minutes and 45 seconds, when in all actuality, from what's been explained to me, is that all of the pairs in the Kraken universe are scanned every 10 seconds. So yes, the filter insights is updating every 30 minutes, but the scan of the symbols within Kraken, from what I was told, was every 10 seconds. And then the last question is, there are no open trades, no active open trades. Why would that be if we've got pairs ready to buy, and then I go into open trades, nothing has been executed? Doesn't make sense. Those should be executed on if they are ready to buy. I mean, the slots are open. We can look at the goal's engine. The max open positions is five, so there are five slots open that could be filled by these pairs that are ready to buy. So I'm not sure why that's not connecting and working. So some progress, but lots of things still to fix.
